text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Transitional National Council postpones debate on Arabic language draft law because of differences.
- President Zeroual's visits to China and Vietnam further economic cooperation.
- Central Bank governor Abdelwahab Keramane says Algeria's foreign reserves at more than $3.5 billion.
- Main workers' union leader Abdelhaq Benhamouda says Moslem fundamentalist parties should change acronyms.
